title: India top-7-cities residential sales (JLL REIS)

source.title: India's luxury homes dominate 2024 sales, crossing 50% mark

methodology: Annual residential unit sales across India's top seven cities, transcribed from JLL's published report. JLL counts apartments only and excludes row houses, villas and plotted developments.

metrics.name: Residential units sold, top 7 cities
metrics.definition: JLL REIS apartment sales across NCR, MMR, Bengaluru, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai and Kolkata.

notes: JLL evidence: 'Residential sales during 2024 witnessed sustained growth reaching a record-high volume of 302,867-unit sales, which was around 11% growth Y-o-Y.' Its table reports 2024 = 302,867 and 2023 = 271,818.

The 2022 figure is JLL's published '215,000 units' Q4-2022 top-seven-cities estimate, as reported by Times Now: https://www.timesnownews.com/business-economy/real-estate/residential-house-sales-in-top-7-cities-touch-decade-high-of-215000-units-despite-high-rates-jll-article-96788676

ANAROCK publishes a broader top-7-cities series (2021: 236,500; 2022: 364,900; 2023: 476,000; 2024: approximately 459,000; 2025: approximately 395,600). It is not mixed with the JLL series because its coverage definition differs. Source: https://websitemedia.anarock.com/media/Milestone_Year_for_Indian_Residential_Real_Estate_2022_ANAROCK_ANNUAL_REPORT_417a9fb439.pdf
